scope: Static source and package review. No host routing evaluation, generation, source integration or deployment.

metadata.name: emotion-hook-director
metadata.description: Direct realistic emotion-led UGC and AI-influencer video hooks. Use when a user asks for a hook video prompt, reaction prompt, facial expression, emotional performance, or a short influencer clip (especially 3–5 seconds). Translate the requested feeling into a believable second-by-second facial and physical performance, with camera, identity, audio, and editing constraints. Works for image-to-video or text-to-video.

metadata.name: ugc-hook-intelligence
metadata.description: Research, transcribe, classify, generate, and validate high-retention, wall-of-text hooks for short-form UGC, SaaS marketing, app demos, and AI-influencer reels. Use for screenshot hook extraction, hook ideation, reaction-based creator ads, silent visual hooks, A/B variations, and 3–5 second intro scripts. Includes a reference library of Instagram hook structures and quality rules.

metadata.name: wall-text-video-generation
metadata.description: VIDEO-ONLY skill. Converts exact, already-approved text from an upstream writing skill into realistic reference-matched 9:16 social-video footage prompts plus a deterministic text-overlay render plan. Routes among close selfie, moving selfie, everyday activity, lifestyle POV, environment-only, persistent-text montage, short statement, and exceptional demo hybrid. Does not author or revise the overlay words.

metadata.name: ugc-native-slideshow
metadata.description: Generate native-looking TikTok, Instagram, Reels, Shorts, and carousel slideshows for UGCpilot. Use when creating, rewriting, structuring, or reviewing slideshow hooks, body-slide copy, slide counts, text hierarchy, product placement, visual intents, typography roles, or slideshow output data. Covers personal-shift listicles, story/confession slideshows, educational methods, quick tips, fitness routines, product-assisted slideshows, and CTA slides.
